description: Expand an RFC 5545 RRULE into concrete occurrences: FREQ (daily/weekly/monthly/yearly), INTERVAL, COUNT, UNTIL, BYDAY with ordinals (2MO = second Monday, -1FR = last Friday), BYMONTHDAY (including negatives), BYMONTH, from a start date, up to 500 dates, with a plain-English reading of the rule. $0.002. Costs $0.002 USDC per call (x402).
name: dates_recurrence
title: dates recurrence
